description: This source file implements a helper daemon for process forking in a sysevent system. It handles signals, initializes a daemon process, reads messages from a pipe, and forks/executed processes based on received commands, primarily to optimize memory usage during process activation.

methods.name: daemon_init
methods.description: Initializes the process as a daemon, creating a new session, changing directory to root, and setting file permissions.

methods.name: deinitialize_system
methods.description: Closes the read pipe, removes the PID file, and logs shutdown message.

methods.name: terminate_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles termination signals, logs the signal, deinitializes, and exits.

methods.name: ignore_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles signals to be ignored, logs receipt.

methods.name: initialize_system
methods.description: Sets up logging, daemonizes the process, configures signal handlers, writes PID to file, and sets OOM adjustment.

methods.name: _eval
methods.description: Forks and executes a specified program with arguments, managing signals and environment, returning success or failure.

methods.name: get_args_and_eval
methods.description: Reads a message from a pipe, parses command details, and forks/executed processes accordingly.
